## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The Chemist reports 304 viable antibiotics after a solubility proxy and notes expiry dates fourteen to twenty-two months ahead. The Chemist interprets this as stock from a distribution cycle interrupted by the world’s end, not as a documented warehouse history. Diesel is described as a breath that ends on Day 195, while grow-light bulbs are at zero and another expedition is planned. Do not add stock quantities or test results absent from this entry. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

## 5. Human center

The source voice is The Chemist. The Chemist distinguishes a laboratory confirmation from a complete solution, then notices how each kind of shortage occupies a different time horizon. Treat conclusions about a never-completed distribution cycle as the Chemist’s inference. The prose may notice what the author can count, hear, repair, fear, or leave uncertain, while keeping the account’s limits visible.
